mapper.select: UPDATE stored_file SET reference_count = reference_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id, typeHandler=com.zija.system.internal.persistence.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND household_id = #{householdId, typeHandler=com.zija.system.internal.persistence.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND reference_count > 0 RETURNING id, household_id, storage_key, original_filename, declared_media_type, detected_media_type, byte_size, sha256, reference_count, created_at
